description: This file defines the Vtiger_Zip class, which is a wrapper around the dZip class for managing ZIP files. It includes methods for downloading ZIP files, path normalization, and copying directories/files into ZIP archives.

classes.name: Vtiger_Zip
classes.description: Wrapper class over dZip for handling ZIP file operations such as download and directory copying.

methods.name: forceDownload
methods.description: Streams the ZIP file to the client for download, setting appropriate headers.

methods.name: __getRelativePath
methods.description: Calculates the relative path from base to source path.

methods.name: __fixDirSeparator
methods.description: Ensures directory paths end with a '/' separator.

methods.name: __normalizePath
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes in paths for normalization.

methods.name: copyDirectoryFromDisk
methods.description: Recursively copies a directory from disk into the ZIP archive.

methods.name: copyFileFromDisk
methods.description: Copies a single file from disk into the ZIP archive.
